text_block_list.text:
With the decisive battle of the Tokyo 
Daishoten right around the corner, 
Christmas Day arrived—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. The early-to-mid race flow 
should work with the image I have now...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The problem lies in that final 
straightaway... My main concern with 
reaching the ideal form is—

Aiming to hone her running to the very 
limit, Hokko Tarumae had been focusing on 
training since early this morning.

And so, once the sun had risen high in the 
sky—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Ah. Oh shoot, is it really that late 
already...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm going to head back to the 
dorm for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Like we talked about earlier, see you 
later!

Hokko Tarumae hurried away from the scene. 
The reason for this goes back just a 
little while—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—About Christmas Day, could you please 
keep your afternoon free for me?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask—? Because this is the only 
place it could be!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A chance to enjoy Christmas!

With that kind of momentum, Hokko Tarumae 
and I ended up having the entire afternoon 
completely off...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainerrr!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! Shall we get 
going right away?
choice_data_list: So, where are we going today?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: That's a surprise for when we arrive!

Led along by a strangely pumped-up Hokko 
Tarumae, the place we arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! It's the 'Furlong Tower'!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Let's go to this observation deck today!

It was even more crowded than usual due to 
Christmas, and access to the observation 
deck was restricted. It seemed difficult 
to get in on the day without planning 
ahead...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. I would appreciate it if 
you didn't underestimate me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've already secured our advance tickets 
for the observation deck! So there's no 
need to worry!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“—That being said, we arrived a bit too 
early before entry opens... Maybe I was 
being a little overly cautious...”
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we walk around a bit?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Since we have the chance, 
let's definitely do that!

Afterward, I took a stroll around Furlong 
Tower with Hokko Tarumae. After enjoying 
ourselves for a while, it was time to head 
up to the observation deck before we knew 
it—

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
—We will soon arrive at the observation 
deck floor.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Trainer! The city lights 
look just like stars...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I'm glad I came to see it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Tracen Academy is over in that 
direction, right? I wonder if the shopping 
street I frequent and the station square 
where I did my local idol morning gigs are 
near there too—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I wanted to burn it into my memory 
before the Tokyo Daishoten."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
All the days I've spent up until today... 
working so hard together with you, 
Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"This scenery... of this place that holds 
so many memories."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure the Tokyo Daishoten is a race I 
can't win unless I pour every second of my 
time up to now into power..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Even more than that—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Haven't we been pushing ourselves way too 
hard without a single break up until 
today...?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...No, I don't really mind either way, but 
at this rate, Trainer, you're gonna end up 
having no Christmas spirit at all—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I kind of feel bad about that...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to thank me. ...As long as 
you get to enjoy the Christmas spirit, 
that's more than enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Then I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I forgot the most 
important greeting. Allow me to start 
over—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Merry Christmas, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

And so, looking down at the town together 
with Hokko Tarumae, we added yet another 
memory—

Afterward, as I was about to head back to 
the academy with Hokko Tarumae—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Ah. Trainer-san, look at that...!

Following Hokko Tarumae's gaze, I saw that 
a Christmas-exclusive outdoor ice skating 
rink had been set up...!

According to the guide, it seems that 
purchasing an observatory ticket grants 
priority access to the ice skating rink.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but... isn't it getting pretty late? 
Will you make curfew...?
choice_data_list:
If they get mad, I'll drop to my knees and 
apologize right alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A dogeza...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufu, ahaha! Oh, what are you even 
saying—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like we get priority entry, so a 
little bit shouldn't hurt, right?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, shall we play around for a 
bit?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I definitely won't break curfew, 
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: âHey, Trainer! Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, honestly, you're hopeless! I'm 
coming right now!

Her joyful smile on the ice beneath the 
shining tower would surely become an 
unforgettable memory for me in the days to 
come...

It became a Christmas that reaffirmed that 
conviction—
